scientific.integrity: The source sign-gated momentum recurrence is specialized to one positive quadratic mode. A one-line sign induction proves permanent momentum erasure after the first overshoot, and a standard Jury calculation gives the exact ordinary-momentum comparison.
limitations: Only the first-overshoot regime is classified.
No claim about stochastic sign errors, multidimensional coupling, or generalization.

title: SPI-Optimizer exactly erases momentum after a scalar overshoot
